prompts.overhead_breaststroke: Edit this overhead ocean photograph: zoom the camera out substantially and change the swimmer to an anatomically credible BREASTSTROKE. Preserve turquoise ocean, true top-down perspective, black wetsuit, yellow cap, sunlight, wide horizontal format and quiet left water. Full swimmer small in the right third, only about 18 to 22 percent of image width, surrounded by much more ocean. Swimmer faces left in the breaststroke pull phase: both arms sweeping out and back symmetrically under the water, elbows bent naturally, hands drawing toward the chest below the water surface; exactly ONE LEFT HAND and ONE RIGHT HAND with correct thumb orientation, hands small and softly refracted through water, not prominent detailed foreground hands. Legs recovering naturally for the frog kick with modest bent knees, all anatomy credible and not contorted. This should read clearly as breaststroke rather than freestyle or straight-arm glide. Natural ripples and subtle wake, not huge explosive spray. No extra limbs, mirrored duplicate hands, broken joints, pool markings, text, logos, UI or watermark.
prompts.pool: Edit this freestyle swimmer photograph. Correct the lane orientation: the swimmer is traveling RIGHT TO LEFT along the length of one lane, matching the direction of the swimmer's head and forward motion. Show a clean side-on water-level view. BOTH bounding lane divider ropes must run HORIZONTALLY LEFT TO RIGHT across the image, parallel to the swimmer's travel. Put one continuous rope in the lower foreground and another continuous rope behind the swimmer in the upper background; neither intersects or attaches to the swimmer's body or elbow. They continue completely to the left and right image edges, beyond the frame. If a floor guide stripe is visible, show exactly one centered stripe running horizontally left-right under the swimmer, not a stripe pointing toward the background. Adjust the background pool geometry as necessary to support this side-on view. Preserve athlete, natural freestyle pose, morning lighting, turquoise water, wide composition and clear quiet left space. No text, logos, UI or watermark.
prompts.dawn: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: warm-up section background for a swimming workout in a dark training app. A cinematic wide editorial photograph of an adult open-water athlete in a simple black swim wetsuit, cap and goggles swimming purposefully through small choppy lake waves at dawn. Water-level camera, athlete on the right half with believable freestyle technique and natural splashes; left half broad dark blue rippled open water to support white overlay text. Distant soft mountains, muted dawn light, determined authentic training mood, premium sports documentary photography. No pool, no lane ropes, no floor stripes, no text, logos, UI or watermark. Wide landscape composition.
prompts.butterfly: Replace the overhead swimmer artwork with a completely different playful cinematic fantasy sports photograph for a swimming workout app. OPEN OCEAN, camera at water level facing an adult athletic swimmer performing BUTTERFLY directly toward the camera. Correct recognizable butterfly technique: BOTH arms recovering simultaneously wide to the sides over the water, broad near-symmetrical wing-like sweep, natural elbows and shoulders, exactly two arms attached correctly at the shoulder joints, anatomically correct hands and five fingers each, no twisted wrists or dislocated joints. Torso forward, head lifting naturally for a butterfly breath, dramatic splash. Place athlete mostly on the right half; leave left half darker blue ocean waves for white workout text. TWO joyful dolphins leap in the background following the athlete, and TWO adult mythical mermaids follow behind at a respectful distance, their faces, elegant covered tops and shimmering fish tails partly visible amid the water. A fun exuberant larger-than-life adventure film still, knowingly fantastical, sunny tropical coast far away, teal-blue ocean, energetic but polished, make the swimmer the clear hero. No pool, lane ropes, overhead camera, freestyle pose, extra limbs, broken arms, logos, text, UI, watermark or borders. Wide landscape composition.
prompts.feet_repair: Edit target: the existing overhead open-water breaststroke photo. Preserve the wide overhead composition, turquoise ocean, small athlete in the right third, yellow cap, black wetsuit and breaststroke arm pose. Change only the swimmer's legs and feet: anatomically correct two legs in a modest natural breaststroke frog kick, knees bent slightly, exactly one left foot and one right foot. Keep the feet below the water and soften their visibility with realistic refraction, a little foam and ripples so individual toes are not discernible. No broken ankles, extra feet or twisted joints. Keep the athlete small; do not zoom in. No text, logos or watermark.

adjacency: Do not use matching filenames or similarity groups in adjacent workout slots. Pool and dawn freestyle share a family; overhead breaststroke and front butterfly are distinct.
